findings.title: Failed journal entry delete hides the entry, which still exists, and shows 'No journal entries yet'
findings.expected: When the delete fails, the entry stays in the list next to the error, because it was not deleted
findings.actual: The entry is removed from the list before the request returns and is not put back when the request fails. The page shows 'Injected 500' and 'No journal entries yet', while the badge says '1 entry' and the API still returns the entry

findings.title: Non-list journal response on the plant page is shown as 'No journal entries yet'
findings.expected: A visible error when the journal response is not a list
findings.actual: No alert appears. The page shows 'No journal entries yet' while the badge says '2 entries'
